The role

The job as the profession describes it: the apprenticeship standard and its assessment plan, the National Careers Service profile, the professional body's competence framework and registration route, the organisation's own job adverts and apprenticeship listings, "day in the life" posts by its apprentices. Tier 3, or tier 2 where the organisation's own pages say it.

Name every file with its date and where it came from, for example 2026-09-17_careers-page_apprenticeships.pdf, and log it in Springpod_LEARN_Organisation_Knowledge_Base_V1.docx.
